purpose: New retrospective finite-population observation-budget and target-measurement sensitivity calculation; not independent source acquisition or model qualification
cohort: All 6 nominal series and all 3 source hot-press temperatures per series; no source/series exclusions based on outcomes
observable: Author-reported TOTAL ionic conductivity, S/cm, target 25 C; direct exact-25C EIS sampling unattested
recommendation: Best observed conductivity among the k revealed historical conditions; selection order fixed without reading outcomes
random_control: Enumerate every k-subset with equal weight; no favorable random seed or Monte Carlo uncertainty
cost: One historical label reveal per observation; equal nominal cost assumption, NOT measured EIS cost or scientific compute budget
H1: HOTTEST_FIRST weakly improves expected regret over exact uniform selection in EVERY series at BOTH budgets 1 and 2, with at least one strict improvement
H1_falsification: Any series/budget has greater regret than exact uniform; no retuning after scoring
measurement_stress_semantics: Independent adversarial +/- epsilon shifts of each target log10 value; hypothetical sensitivity, NOT measured EIS error or calibrated probability
H2: Every nominal-series source winner remains uniquely best for all target-label shifts bounded by epsilon=0.1 log10
H2_falsification: Any top-to-runner-up log10 gap <= 2*epsilon; ties do not certify unique winner
model_comparators: Frozen conventional process Ridge and O_ONLY/pooled composition RF remain ABSTAIN/NOT_APPLICABLE: hot-press domain and/or complete source condition composition unqualified; no fabricated predictions
uncertainty: Source measurement uncertainty and physical specimen independence UNKNOWN; exact enumeration uncertainty concerns only the fixed sampling rule, not source population generalization
acceptance: Complete all series/budgets and adversarial tests, preserve provenance and failures, report both hypothesis verdicts; no superiority requirement imposed on outcomes
